summary: Evidence verifier: a pass replaces a failure only when dated more than two minutes later (no burying a failure with a back-dated or skewed pass)

schema.detail: No daemon claim or portable record change.

rules.detail: scripts/evidence-verify orders records by the signer's observed_at, which the signer controls. A pass now supersedes a failure for the same tree and check only when its observed_at is more than two minutes (the existing future-date margin) later than the failure; an equal, inverted or closer date leaves the failure standing. A rerun a few seconds after a failure on the same tree no longer lifts it until the margin passes. Every enforce stays false, so no job is skipped or rejected by this change; the gate's shadow decisions can read check_failed slightly longer after a failure.

compatibility.detail: Only the rare case of a pass dated within two minutes after a failure on the identical tree and check changes outcome (it stays failed).

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous ordering; no state is written.
